2609.31572.title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
2609.31572.paper_summary: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while maintaining a shared camera, rotation axis, and pivot. This orbit-consistent refinement jointly optimizes image-derived geometry and angles to reconstruct objects from sparse, irregular captures. On rendered objects with 12, 8, and 6 irregularly spaced views, OC-GS achieves mean foreground PSNR scores of 21.26, 19.36, and 15.83dB, respectively, exceeding all four evaluated pose-free Gaussian splatting baselines in each condition. Under a shared trainer, refining image-estimated angles improves mean foreground PSNR by 7.88dB over keeping those estimates fixed. An ablation study shows that both image-derived angle initialization and the shared motion model contribute to the improvement. On real captures, OC-GS's refinement increases mean foreground PSNR by 0.70dB. Results show that refining uncertain angles within a shared motion model improves reconstruction from sparse, irregular turntable captures.
2609.31572.paper_summary_zh: 不均勻的旋轉和丟幀使得等角假設在轉盤重建中不可靠。我們提出了OC-GS，一種物體中心的高斯噴灑技術，它在保持共享相機、旋轉軸和樞紐的同時，細化每個圖像的角度。這種軌道一致的細化共同優化了圖像衍生的幾何形狀和角度，以從稀疏、不規則的捕獲中重建物體。在具有12、8和6個不規則間隔視圖的渲染物體上，OC-GS分別達到了21.26、19.36和15.83dB的平均前景PSNR分數，超過了每種條件下評估的四個無姿態高斯噴灑基準。在共享訓練器下，細化圖像估計的角度使平均前景PSNR提高了7.88dB，相較於固定這些估計值。消融研究表明，圖像衍生的角度初始化和共享運動模型都對改進有所貢獻。在真實捕獲中，OC-GS的細化使平均前景PSNR提高了0.70dB。結果顯示，在共享運動模型內細化不確定的角度可以改善從稀疏、不規則轉盤捕獲中進行的重建。
2609.31572.author: Jae Joong Lee et.al.
